status: Written at P4-2 from Isaiah's decisions P4Q9 to P4Q31 (PASS4_STATUS.md, Decision log). It holds only what the frozen spec leaves open (P4Q4); everything else is as the spec, the amendments and the decision records define it. The confirmation module reads this file from P4-4 and refuses any other, and a test pins its SHA-256 then. A change before the dev run makes a new version, recorded with its reason; a change after it is a disclosed deviation (P4Q1).

sources.decisions: PASS4_STATUS.md, Decision log: P4Q1 to P4Q8 (the standing prompt) and P4Q9 to P4Q31 (P4-2)

dev.loader: io.load_dev (the dev panel, verified by the spec's hash)

confirmation.join: the dev rows and the confirmation rows concatenated, then targets.add_targets on the joined frame, so that every beta continues across the samples (AM-03, P17)

constants.c_cw_rule: the primary forecast comparison (Clark-West, M3 against M2, one-sided) rejects if and only if its statistic is strictly greater than c_cw_cal (AM-09); a helper applies it to the statistic of fctests.clark_west

confirmatory.fit: one joint fit (inference.fit_joint) on the confirmation rows dated in the period, with its own T and its own DK lag by the spec's lag rule

descriptive.fit: one joint fit on the confirmation rows dated in the period, with its own T and its own DK lag

f.disclosure: the 2022 fit has about a quarter of T_conf, so its DK-normal intervals are not calibrated at its T

dev.fit: one joint fit on the whole dev estimation sample
dev.label: dev stand-in
dev.periods: not applicable on dev by design (dev ends 2021-12-30); exercised on synthetic data

reporting_form.with_and_without_rule: b with and without the row's change on the same rows, next to the full-sample primary b, with the DK lag at that row's T (AM-05; P56)
reporting_form.own_estimates_rule: the row's own estimates with DK SEs, next to the full-sample primary b

beta_rolling_250.beta: the past-only OLS slope of y_oc on y_1306_oc over the last 250 eligible rows (non-excluded, lag 1 day, continued across samples), as targets.past_beta computes the rolling-500 beta of AM-05
beta_rolling_250.rows: the primary rows with a finite rolling-250 beta

copx_to_fcx.rows: the primary rows with a finite fcx_oc

xau_control.rows: the primary rows with a finite xau_ret; the rows and dates dropped are reported

mechanism_session_fx_gotobi.rows: the primary rows on which c_usdjpy_sess_ret, c_eurusd_sess_ret and gotobi_day are all finite; the rows and dates dropped are reported

post_2024_11_05_indicator_CONFIRMATION_O.on_dev: not applicable by design (post is identically 0 on dev); exercised on synthetic data with a known break (P4Q5)

per_ticker_slopes_holm.design: one pooled DK fit with usdjpy_ret and eurusd_ret both ticker-specific (the fixed effects and controls already are), so its point estimates equal per-stock regressions
per_ticker_slopes_holm.test: Holm across the three two-sided p-values of the usdjpy_ret slopes

confirmation.rule: each walk_forward call runs on the joined dev and confirmation rows; the comparisons, the report_all items, the importance and the economic evaluation use only the evaluation rows on confirmation dates

dev.rule: every dev forecast row, from the first forecast after the 500th eligible training date to 2021-12-30; the confirmation-date restriction is exercised on synthetic data; Clark-West is shown against both the normal reference and c_cw_cal, as exploratory

m7_call.rule: M0 is added to M7's call, so that M7's OOS R2 against M0 is reported; M0 reads no feature, so the call's sample is unchanged

importance.rule: permutation importance for M7 only, calibrated against its noise column

seeds.rule: every walk_forward call uses the spec seed, the engine's default

outputs: the break-even of M3, of M2 and their difference (mean gross P&L per name-day, bp)
the primary, low and high mean round trips beside them
the mean net P&L per name-day under each of the three cost cases

tick_terms.rule: at the confirmation, x_m and x_h are recomputed by D2.4's and D2.5's rules on the confirmation rows' own open and close prices; the locked SESOI is unchanged

tier_ii.requires: AM-05's criterion on the eligible confirmation nights
tier_ii.condition_3: signed: b_with / b_without >= 0.5 on point estimates; it fails if the two differ in sign, or if b_without is zero or not finite

report_without_tier_reading: H3: a2-hat, its DK SE and two-sided p
copx_to_fcx, with and without the swap on the same rows
raw_target, with the gap a2-hat(raw) minus a2-hat(abn)
tier_iii.a2_reading: a2 is the session drift on EUR/USD conditional on usdjpy_ret, SPY and COPX; its sign is not attributed to the metals channel (docs/P4_M2_note.md, Propositions 1, 2 and 5)

equivalence.wording: no drift exploitable net of costs
equivalence.when: TOST declares equivalence at the primary SESOI
equivalence.beside: whether TOST also declares it at the low and at the high SESOI

null_h1.rule: a null H1 is read against MDE80, never as no effect; the sentences of P23 and PLAN 1.4 on full pricing are not used

claims.reading_of_b: qualified in the pre-registration (flag F4-3; docs/P4_M2_note.md, Proposition 4)

recovery.rule: P4Q5's criteria plus numeric tolerances for b-hat and b_post against the known values, stated in the dry-run item's message before the run

seeds.rule: the spec seed plus a new offset block, disjoint from the B7, B7b, C7 and sealed-run blocks (D4.5's pattern); the offset is set in the dry-run item

forward_holdout.rule: what it evaluates is fixed in the pre-registration (Pass 5)

contingencies.principle: the confirmation run never stops to ask (P13(c))
contingencies.not_estimable: a row with no rows, a rank-deficient design, or a non-finite estimate or SE it reports is reported as not estimable, with its reason and its row and date counts, and the run continues
contingencies.undefined_ratio: a ratio with a zero or non-finite denominator is undefined, and a criterion that needs it fails
contingencies.holm: a member of a Holm family that is not estimable enters with p = 1, so the family size is unchanged
contingencies.claims: a claim whose inputs include a not-estimable result is not made
